summary: Iter 268 — Pulse Service Desk dashboard stat-card deep links to Customers tab with correct status filter. Tested via real browser (admin@gymaxisai.com Master Admin) at /service-desk. All 4 KPI stat cards now apply the correct status filter on click and via keyboard (Enter/Space). Total Customers -> ''; Active -> 'active'; Pending Invite -> 'pending_invite'; Archived -> 'archived'. Recent Activity navigates to Audit tab (no status dropdown). Manage Customers quick action opens Customers with empty filter. Switching cards updates the filter correctly (no stuck state). No regressions, no console errors related to the feature.
critical_code_review_comments: DeskSummary.js — non-provider stats array correctly carries status per card; provider branch (cases/engineers/customers) does not pass status which is fine since provider Customers component does not accept initialStatus. OK.

ServiceDeskPage.js — equipment/suppliers fallback for providers also calls onNavigate with status (harmless dead branch). Minor: customerStatus is not reset when the user clicks a sidebar tab manually, but that's outside the requested behaviour and would only ever pre-populate to the last clicked card's filter on a subsequent navigation; non-blocking.
DeskCustomers.js — useEffect on initialStatus correctly re-syncs the status dropdown when the prop changes (covers the 'switch between cards' case).
test_credentials: admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123! (Master Admin — non-provider Pulse desk)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pulse Master Admin desk (non-provider) uses 4 KPI cards: desk-stat-total-customers, desk-stat-active, desk-stat-pending-invite, desk-stat-archived. Each navigates to Customers tab and pre-sets desk-filter-status. Recent Activity card (desk-stat-recent-activity) -> Audit tab. Manage Customers quick action (desk-quick-manage-customers) -> Customers with no filter. All verified working.
rca_of_the_issue: Iter 268 fix already verified — DeskSummary's stats array adds a `status` field per card and onNavigate(goto, status) is plumbed through ServiceDeskPage's customerStatus state into DeskCustomers' initialStatus prop. A useEffect in DeskCustomers re-applies the new status whenever initialStatus changes, eliminating the stale-filter bug.
